name: allocation_id
description: Unique SCD-2 capacity allocation record identifier.

name: order_id
description: Optional commercial order_id pin when funded against a specific cohort.

name: runtime_pool_id
description: Merged FCFS runtime pool bucket identifier.

name: app_id
description: Funded application identifier in app_registry (NULL when funded at business-unit level).

name: funded_units
description: Funded share of committed capacity units owned by this consumer.

name: effective_from
description: SCD-2 inclusive UTC start timestamp for this allocation.

name: effective_to
description: SCD-2 exclusive UTC end timestamp (NULL while active).
